extraction_method: web fetch of Inter-American Dialogue blog post 'Remittance Transfers in 2025: The Year in Review' by Manuel Orozco (2026-01-02).

deportation_impacted_segment_profile.value: Majority of deported migrants had lived in the US 4+ years and sent remittances regularly — not recent arrivals.

irregular_entry_share_below_50pct.value: Irregular entry now represents less than 50% of total migration for Dominican Republic, Jamaica, Mexico, El Salvador.

value.context: highest growth rates in 20 years for most LAC countries

mexico_negative_performer.value: Mexico was the only negative-performer among major LAC corridors in 2025. Drivers: ~4% of remitters ceased sending; <1% new senders initiated transfers; lower volume without migration increases.

average_transaction_change_2025.value: 27% increase in average amounts sent per transaction
average_transaction_change_2025.notes: Attributed to risk-mitigation behavior by migrants facing deportation threat — senders concentrating transfers.

remittance_income_share.value: Migrants may be sending 15%+ of income as remittances

tax_elasticity.value: 1% cost decrease causes approximately $32 reduction in remittance amount sent

deportation_pressure.value: Sustained deportation wave + declining irregular entry -> potential remittance decline. Senders adjusting behavior (consolidating transfers, using accounts more) as risk mitigation.

fincen_verification_pressure.value: FinCEN scrutinizing transactions over US$2,000; potential new verification requirements for work authorization

stablecoin_adoption_emerging_risk.value: Stablecoin adoption growing in FX mechanisms; emerging risk vector outside traditional MSB oversight.

industry_consolidation_2025.value: Western Union acquiring Intermex for US$500M (expected completion mid-2026) -> Western Union reaches ~30% market share. Other leaders: Remitly (largest 2025 market share), Viamericas (US$113.6M financing), Felix Pago (US$75M Series B). Backend consolidation: Transnetwork, ApprizaPay, Uniteller.

suitable_for_grounding_fields: remittance_cadence (via deportation-risk consolidation pattern, 27% avg-size increase)
loss_tolerance_usd (via $4 added per-transaction tax = meaningful for small-amount senders)
persona_grounding_implications.behavioral_evidence_grade_when_used: C — industry/think-tank behavioral research. Orozco / IAD is the most-cited analyst of LAC remittances; high credibility for aggregate trends, lighter on individual-persona detail.
persona_grounding_implications.note: This source captures the current (2025-2026) market state. For persona grounding, it anchors the CURRENT plausible sender behavior; pair with Remitly 10-K and Wise report for historical/structural context.
